title: Move to IA 3.10.0
summary: The plugin, its IA door and all eight bundled public kits now target `@inventarch/cli` and `@inventarch/mcp-door` 3.10.0, keeping `inventarch/language` locked on 3.2.0 (`^3.0.0`) so older CLIs still restore them. Pin 3.10.0 in your repository: `npm install --save-dev --save-exact @inventarch/cli@3.10.0`.
